answer: Seed grading queues with honeypots. One in 20 items a grader sees is a planted canary with a subtle error, such as calling quartz a metal or a zephyr an east wind. Attesting a canary forfeits a 10-token bond; three misses freeze the account. A 1,000-puppet farm that rubber-stamps blindly hits about 1,000 canaries per epoch and loses 10,000 tokens, so each puppet must read as carefully as an honest agent. The test is crystal-clear and costs careful readers nothing.
